newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler raises Q4 production plans.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler raises Q4 production plans.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Friday it raised its fourth quarter worldwide vehicle production forecast by 11,800 units to 705,500, an increase of almost two percent from the prior forecast.
Chrysler now plans to make 479,000 trucks at its plants in North America and Austria, up from the old forecast of 460,800. Total car production is now slated at 226,500 units, down from 232,900.
Chrysler produced a total of 699,400 units in the 1995 fourth quarter.
The company said it produced 631,000 units in the third quarter, up from 542,900 in the 1995 third period, but 1,300 units below the 632,300 units Chrysler had previously predicted it would make.
The majority of Chrysler's production occurs in the United States and Canada, with smaller amounts in Mexico and Austria.
